question: Fully-grounded answers fell from 9/15 (60.0%) at 15 answerable questions to 11/29 (37.9%) at 30. Did the generator get worse, did the 128-token cap start biting, or did the question mix change?
finding: The generator did not change. The 15 batch-1 questions scored 8/15 grounded here against 9/15 in the earlier run — the same behaviour within one answer. The drop is entirely in the questions added: batch 2 scored 4/15. And within batch 2 it is one category: multi_article scored 0 grounded out of 9, with 8 of 9 answers carrying no citation at all. direct scored 7/12 and colloquial 5/9. The earlier run had only 3 multi_article questions; this one has 9.
token_cap_is_a_contributor_not_the_cause: All 5 answers cut by the 128-token cap were uncited, so the cap does cost citations — a truncated Arabic answer loses its trailing [مادة N]. But 11 of the 16 uncited answers were never truncated, and only 2 of the 9 multi_article failures were. Raising the cap would recover at most 5 and would not touch the multi_article result.
next_experiment: Re-run with a larger max_new_tokens to separate the cap's contribution from the model's, and try the `gated` claims contract on multi_article specifically — an answer that must name its articles before writing prose is the intervention aimed at exactly this failure.
unchanged: Zero fabricated citations, at twice the questions. That is the claim this project rests on and it did not move.
